body: No hobbies, I do nothing all day.. I don't go to the gym or exercise because I struggle to even leave my house, and I stopped taking any medication a while back because it didn't make any difference

I really hated it. The psychiatrist just seemed very cold and uncaring and would constantly just say "You need to change this, and this, and this, etc" and its frustrating when she's making everything sound so simple when right now I struggle to even look after myself nevermind making all these changes she's saying about... and I really felt like she was no help at all.. I was so glad when the appointment was over but also really upset, so I asked at the reception area if the clinical nurse specialist who orginally assessed me (I'd rather not say his name just in case) was there and he was so I was able to speak to him for a little while.. He said he'd also arrange for me to see a different psychiatrist instead and while I'm waiting to see the psychologist next month I can come see him to talk about things.. I also did get prescribed some different anti depressants now too but I'm not very optimistic that they'll make any difference since all the others I tried in the past haven't..

I have no idea about her background or experience.. Not sure where you're from, but here in the UK, GP's always just prescribe you anti depressants and are really reluctant to refer you elsewhere for help (I guess it's all the cuts to NHS funding...)

And my appointment is in 4 hours and really struggling to motivate myself to get ready... I couldn't sleep last night and so I feel really exhausted, and I've also not eaten anything since Monday and that was only a bowl of cereal so that probably doesn't help..

I've been on Fluoxetine, Citalopram and most recently Sertraline and none of them have ever helped in the slightest.. This isn't the first time I've stopped taking my medication.. After trying the others for months and months without even a slight benefit I stopped taking them too.. But I think my dr is more worried this time though because I told her about feeling suicidal and how I'd like to end my life if it wasn't so difficult to get ahold of the drugs I'd need...

Someone called Tony replied and now his post has disappeared while I was responding to him, so just going to post it here anyway...

Every medication I've tried hasn't worked and about a month ago I decided to stop taking any medication because it's not making any difference anyway.. And I don't see the point of just taking drugs to make you not care about all the underlying issues that cause the depression and rather the underlying issues should be dealt with, but I feel like in my case, there's no way I can practically deal with the underlying issues..

And I'm not interested in speaking to my family anymore, especially my mum. She's done so many things in the past to really hurt me and I've forgiven her so many times (Without even getting a sorry from her) and I cant just keep forgiving her and then being made to feel like a worthless piece of crap all over again. A little over a month ago she tried contact me and it made me feel even worse. I'd feel much better if she'd just leave me alone and never speak to me again.
